purpose.zh: 转转上背和腰，久坐僵了松一松
purpose.en: Turns your upper back and waist to ease stiffness from sitting.

text.zh: 坐直，身子转向一边，手扶椅背
text.en: Sit tall, turn to one side and hold the backrest

text.zh: 另一只手扶在转过去那边的膝盖外面。
text.en: Other hand on the outside of the knee on the side you turn to.

text.zh: 转到胸口对着椅背就停，脑袋跟着慢慢转过去。
text.en: Turn until your chest faces the backrest, head following slowly.

text.zh: 转到有感觉就停，别用手硬掰椅背。
text.en: Stop when you feel it. Don't crank yourself around with your hands.

commonErrors.en: Yanking with your hands to go further.
Shifting your butt on the seat as you turn.

cautions.zh: 腰扭着疼就转一半，坐直了再转
cautions.en: If your back hurts in the twist, only turn halfway and sit taller.

set.zh: 背挺直，坐得越高转得越顺
set.en: A tall back turns more freely

set.zh: 手扶着椅背就好，不用猛拉
set.en: Hands just rest on the chair, no yanking

set.zh: 胸口对着椅背就够，屁股不挪
